ns0:svg.ns0:title: Complex power triangle
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: The example S=30+j40 VA has horizontal real power 30 W, vertical positive reactive power 40 var and magnitude 50 VA. Positive Q indicates lagging current for this passive load.
